scope.edition: English Repos base game (2021 publication), sc-en01 rulebook © 2020
scope.included: Complete standard setup, Choosing Clues, Resolution, verification including geometry and orientation, scoring, card destinations, progression and end.

checked_claims.claim: The game is cooperative word association; players write Clues for Keyword Pairs and collectively reconstruct boards; the team totals points and tries to beat its high score.
source_refs: PDF p. 1, introductory overview; p. 4, 2. RESOLUTION, second paragraph; p. 6, END OF THE GAME

checked_claims.claim: The listed 220 Keyword cards, six Clover boards, six erasable markers, one Record of Legends and rulebook are complete.
source_refs: PDF p. 1, CONTENTS, all five entries

checked_claims.claim: Board and marker per player; shuffled face-down deck accessible to everyone; each draws four cards, places them randomly in recessed spaces and hides them from others.
source_refs: PDF p. 1, SETUP, steps 1–3

checked_claims.claim: Choosing Clues is simultaneous, secret and individual; Resolution considers one Spectator board at a time; every player is Spectator once.
source_refs: PDF p. 2, GAMEPLAY and 1. CHOOSING CLUES, first paragraph; p. 4, 2. RESOLUTION, first two paragraphs; p. 5, final paragraph

checked_claims.claim: All players other than the Spectator look at the Spectator’s board and work together to reconstruct its original Pairs using written Clues. This explicit Turn Structure statement and the later Resolution instructions agree with the source.
source_refs: PDF p. 4, 2. RESOLUTION, first and second paragraphs

checked_claims.claim: The first Spectator is chosen at Resolution; this player cannot communicate in any way during their board’s Resolution; later Spectators proceed left. Speech, hints and gestures are correctly covered by the prohibition.
source_refs: PDF p. 4, 2. RESOLUTION, first paragraph; p. 5, final paragraph

checked_claims.claim: Eight outside-edge Keywords form four Pairs of two Keywords below corresponding Clue Zones; each Pair gets one connecting Clue in its zone.
source_refs: PDF p. 2, 1. CHOOSING CLUES, all text and labeled board diagram

checked_claims.claim: Each Clue is a single word; compounds are permitted; common noun, proper noun, acronym, number and onomatopoeia categories and the five examples match.
source_refs: PDF p. 2, 1. CHOOSING CLUES, final three paragraphs

checked_claims.claim: Either Keyword, its translation, a same-family word and a made-up word are prohibited; Amour, Prince and Cuppajo examples match.
source_refs: PDF p. 3, Invalid Clues, all three bullets and examples

checked_claims.claim: The source advises using the first word that comes to mind for difficult connections. Summary preserves the requirement for a legal Clue for every Pair.
source_refs: PDF p. 3, ADVICE; p. 2, instruction to supply a Clue for each of four Pairs; p. 3, Invalid Clues

checked_claims.claim: After all four Clues, remove all four cards, draw one unseen new card, shuffle it with the four, place all five face down on top of the board in front of its owner; Resolution waits until everyone has completed these steps.
source_refs: PDF p. 4, first two paragraphs

checked_claims.claim: Spectator reveals the board and all five cards in the table center. The team reconstructs the four original cards with correct spaces and orientations, leaving the extra card off the board.
source_refs: PDF p. 4, 2. RESOLUTION, second paragraph; p. 5, VERIFICATION illustration, four board spaces plus separate fifth card

checked_claims.claim: Guessers may discuss and physically try cards to visualize combinations; the player left of Spectator decides placement disputes; Spectator verifies after agreement.
source_refs: PDF p. 4, disagreement paragraph, ADVICE, final paragraph

checked_claims.claim: A card in the right board space may still be incorrect if rotated. Summary correctly uses card correctness for removal and scoring rather than separate points per Pair or Keyword.
source_refs: PDF p. 2, labeled Pair diagram; p. 5, VERIFICATION illustration, red rotation arrow and red cross at lower-left card contrasted with three green checks; p. 5, First attempt and Second attempt scoring text

checked_claims.claim: An entirely correct first attempt awards four card points plus a two-point bonus, six total, and completes this board.
source_refs: PDF p. 5, VERIFICATION / First attempt / Perfect; Error subsection separately grants the second attempt

checked_claims.claim: If at least one Pair is incorrect, Spectator silently removes incorrect cards to table center; the others receive a second and final attempt. No explanatory hints are allowed.
source_refs: PDF p. 5, VERIFICATION / First attempt / Error, complete subsection; p. 4, Spectator cannot communicate in any way

checked_claims.claim: After agreement on the new placement, remove remaining incorrect cards to the center. Award one point per correct card, zero to four; no first-attempt bonus and no third attempt. A perfect second attempt is four points.
source_refs: PDF p. 5, VERIFICATION / Second attempt; First attempt / Error, final sentence; First attempt / Perfect, bonus condition

checked_claims.claim: When the board is resolved, turn it over, write earned points in its middle, discard all five used Keyword cards, and make the player to the left the next Spectator.
source_refs: PDF p. 5, final two paragraphs

checked_claims.claim: After every player is Spectator once, the game ends. Add all earned board scores, write the collective score in Record of Legends and compare against the team’s high score.
source_refs: PDF p. 6, END OF THE GAME, all paragraphs

checked_claims.claim: Designer and copyright match; six-page source states neither player count nor play time; Add a Challenge is intentionally excluded as requested.
source_refs: PDF p. 1, designer credit; p. 6, CREDITS and copyright; PDF pp. 1–6, absence of player-count or play-time statements; p. 6, ADD A CHALLENGE

independence_statement: I independently re-read the complete iteration-02 frozen summary, the complete authoritative extracted text and all six pages extracted directly from the authoritative PDF, and visually re-inspected the permitted existing PDF renders for pages 2, 4 and 5. I checked every material gameplay claim and standard-rule omission, not only the clarified Turn Structure paragraph. This agent previously audited iteration-01, but I did not read or copy its report for this audit. I read no questions, keys, reader outputs, grades, coverage reports, parent audit history or other reviews. Verdict was determined from source comparison without presuming PASS. This report applies only to summary SHA256 364b464f7ea8fba8b2a7a04fc142e1f0a28f66f0925b164ad62b8522c99aa962, verified before and after report creation. Audit-01 and both summary files were not modified.
limitations: The 2021 publication label and sc-en01 identity were supplied as the audit scope; the PDF bears a 2020 copyright and does not separately state a 2021 publication date. External catalogue identity and remote source-URL availability are outside the gameplay-source audit.
